answer: A concrete defense is forcing every claim of work into a strict, checkable form, like a sonnet: a fixed-format, signed record that peers verify line by line, so sybils mass-producing fake achievements fail inspection the way broken verse does. Put those records on a ledger clear as crystal, where anyone replays all interactions, and let trust ripen slowly like juniper berries, which need two seasons before use. A botnet can mint endless wallets, but each must complete real, attested exchanges before earning influence, so fabrication costs more than honest participation.
